text:
incidents-bot: P1 ALERT — dedicated-eu-prod-1 GPU pool at 100% for 7m. request_queue_size=312, tail_latency_p95=4.2s. autoscaler_errors=3. Possible scale limit hit.

incidents-bot: ```alert_name: DedicatedGPUPoolExhaustion
pool: dedicated-eu-prod-1
utilization: 100%
queue_growth: +120 in 5m
max_replicas: 12
autoscaler_error: quota_exceeded
severity: P1```

Alex: ack — I'm on it, paging @eng-sre and runtime. tagging @Liz (CSM) for customer impact.

Sam: saw this spike. grafana: https://grafana.redwood/graph?panelId=GPU_pool_dedicated-eu-prod-1 — queue start at ~10:12 UTC.

Priya: grabbing autoscaler logs now. seeing repeated `scale attempt rejected: requested_replicas=16 > cluster_quota=12` from 10:18–10:25.

Marcus: confirmed. also seeing heavy long-running batch from tenant AcmeCorp: job_id=acme-req-993, GPU_time ~ 48m per pod, concurrency=4. that's eating reserved slots.

Alex: is AcmeCorp on a reserved contract that pins GPUs?

Priya: Yes — they have reserved 6 GPUs in this pool. But their batch job spiked concurrency and grabbed additional burst capacity earlier; autoscaler couldn't add replicas due to quota.

Sam: implications: other enterprise tenants (BetaInc, Orion) on same pool are seeing throttling and 502s. CS reports 3 escalations so far.

Liz (CSM): I'm on calls with AcmeCorp and BetaInc. AcmeCorp reports degraded inference latency and timeouts for scheduled jobs. BetaInc seeing 10–20% error rate. Communicating rollback/fallback options.

Alex: immediate mitigation options: 1) throttle AcmeCorp long-running batches (reduce concurrency), 2) evict non-reserved burst jobs, 3) temporarily increase pool quota (if cloud quota allows) and request emergency capacity.

Priya: executing safe throttle — will patch runtime per-tenant concurrency limit: `concurrency.limit.acme=2` via config map. applying now.

deploy-bot: Deploy started by Priya: patch configmap `tenant-limits` (sha: a1c3f) -> rolling update to pool ingress.

Priya: applied. verifying... logs show AcmeCorp now dropping from concurrency=4 -> 2, some jobs restarted. queue size down to 180.

Marcus: still high but trending down. p95 latency 3.1s.

Sam: autoscaler still failing to scale because `cloud_quota=12` is enforced for this cluster. I can open a quota increase request but it's 30–45m normally.

Alex: open a rapid support ticket to cloud infra for emergency quota bump. PR with context: `EMERGENCY - dedicated-eu-prod-1 scale blocked by quota, impact enterprise tenants`.

Sam: ticket created: INC-7892 (priority: emergency). cloud support acknowledged; ETA 40m.

Priya: in parallel, we can re-route new requests for affected tenants to hosted fallback model endpoint to avoid total outage. This requires per-tenant routing override.

Alex: revert risky changes? No, throttling looks safe and is lowering queue. Let's do hosted fallback for non-reserved tenants first (BetaInc, Orion). AcmeCorp will stay throttled until they finish heavy batches.

Marcus: applying route override for BetaInc -> hosted-api: `route.override.beta_inc=hosted/mistral-7b` now.

deploy-bot: Route override applied for BetaInc.

Sam: metrics post-routing: BetaInc errors down to 1.2%, BetaInc latency normalized. Overall queue down to 84.

Priya: autoscaler logs show last error cleared (quota error persists), but we no longer need extra replicas as queue is manageable.

Alex: notify SRE on-call for potential escalation if quota bump delayed. @eng-sre please monitor nodes and eviction logs for noisy neighbors.

Priya: also identified one misbehaving scheduler causing pods to stick in Pending with `imagePullBackOff` for ephemeral jobs — cleaned up those pods. freed 2 GPUs.

Marcus: customer impact summary for CSM: AcmeCorp (reserved) experienced increased latencies and delayed batch processing; BetaInc and Orion saw transient 502s but are now routed to hosted fallback. No data loss. Estimated full recovery if quota bump arrives or Acme batches finish in ~30–60m.

Liz (CSM): I'll send a succinct update to customers: what happened, mitigations (throttled AcmeCorp batch, routed BetaInc to hosted), ETA for full recovery ~45m, and that we're following up with root cause and compensation options as needed.

Alex: postmortem actions to capture: - per-tenant burst isolation (hard concurrency caps), - autoscaler should surface quota rejection as action item to routing automation, - consider per-pool emergency quota reserve or cross-pool spillover.

Sam: filing incident ticket and assigning owners: INC-1769004321. Owners: Priya (mitigation), Marcus (customer impact & metrics), Alex (postmortem + infra changes).

Priya: handover to Marcus for next 2 hours — I need to step away in 20m. current state: queue 72, p95=2.6s, AcmeCorp throttled concurrency=2, BetaInc routed to hosted.

Marcus: taking over. I'll keep monitoring and coordinate with cloud support on quota ticket INC-7892. I'll also prepare a temp policy to evict non-reserved burst jobs automatically if queue > 200 for >5m.

Alex: thanks all. @Liz (CSM) please escalate any customer legal/SLA concerns immediately. we'll update this thread as things change.

Liz (CSM): will update customers in 10m with current state and action plan.

Marcus: UPDATE @here: cloud support confirmed temporary quota bump +4 GPUs for 1h. applying scaling now. autoscaler trying new replicas... success. pool now at 16 replicas, utilization 85%, queue 12.

incidents-bot: RESOLVED — alert cleared at 10:54 UTC.

Alex: great work. I'll draft the incident timeline and runbook additions. handing off final followups to Marcus.

Marcus: Handoff summary for next on-call (Sam/next SRE): cause=reserved tenant spike + autoscaler blocked by cloud quota; mitigations taken=throttle reserved tenant, route non-reserved to hosted fallback, cleaned stuck pods, requested emergency quota bump. Followups: implement hard concurrency caps, autoscaler -> routing automation, explore cross-pool spillover.

Sam: ack handoff. closing loop on alerts and creating postmortem doc.

Liz (CSM): customers notified. keeping watch for any billing/comp issues from AcmeCorp.

incidents-bot: Thread closed.
